title: Trace checkpoint normalization through every constructor and cache
applies_when: A multimodal processor hard-codes image_mean/image_std, has image and video entrypoints, or is reconstructed separately by a disaggregated encoder.
lesson: Use statistics from the already-loaded checkpoint image processor, preserving the documented legacy fallback. Trace ordinary construction and independent encoder construction separately; a constructor-only repair can leave encoder requests unchanged. Forward optional processor context through the existing signature-aware hook adapter so legacy three-argument hooks remain valid. Exercise image, video, an audio-first lazy initialization followed by image, missing-statistics controls, and checkpoint A/B/A in one process. Cache keys must include normalization statistics as well as device; device-only caching can reuse another checkpoint's tensors. Compare actual normalized pixels against independent arithmetic, not merely whether a configuration field was stored.
avoid_when: Different checkpoints can intentionally use different statistics: neither CLIP nor ImageNet is a universal correction. A separate preprocessor_config is not necessarily embedded in model config. Do not add an unpinned download or change revision/trust settings to recover data already loaded by the caller. Compare numeric statistics, not list-versus-tuple container equality: a real HF config loader can return tuples. The cited evidence does not prove model accuracy, GPU behavior, upstream acceptance or evidence-selector utility. Source-export tests are not full-package tests, and cached nonexact dependencies are not official CI qualification.

evidence.note: Reporter distinguishes MiMo-VL CLIP statistics from MiMo-V2.6 checkpoint ImageNet statistics. This is the reported contract and motivation, not an independently reproduced model-accuracy result.

Exact source has CLIP pixel constants, a device-only mean/std cache, ordinary MiMoV2Processor construction and separate image/video transforms. These are source facts, not a general claim that CLIP normalization is wrong.

preprocess_mm_for_encoder lazily constructs a separate MiMoProcessor from model configuration; repairing only the ordinary processor constructor does not propagate loaded checkpoint statistics to this path.

invoke_encoder_preprocessor already filters optional context against the hook signature, allowing processor context without breaking legacy hooks. Inspect the video caller too: it can bypass this adapter.

Public candidate patch and seven registered assertions; not a submitted or accepted PR. Exact committed LF blobs match the retained full-package CPU pair: old five numerical assertions fail (wrapped by the test retry helper), two controls pass; candidate 7/7 on cached nonexact dependencies. Retrospective source-export mutations retain only ordinary construction, omit video context, or keep a device-only cache; identical assertions reject them with 2/1/2 failures. This supports test discrimination and route coverage, not prospective selector benefit, official CI or model accuracy.
